name: org.splits/pact-mcp
description: CLI, MCP server, and agent skill for PACT: raise small onchain rounds in USDC on Base.
title: PACT

environmentVariables.name: PACT_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: JSON-RPC endpoint; defaults to the public Base RPC

environmentVariables.name: PACT_CHAIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: Expected chain id; the CLI refuses to run if the RPC disagrees

environmentVariables.name: PACT_FACTORY_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: OfferingFactory address; defaults to the pinned Base deployment

environmentVariables.name: PACT_FACTORY_DEPLOY_BLOCK
environmentVariables.description: Lower bound for OfferingCreated scans; defaults to the pin's block, or 0 when the factory is overridden

environmentVariables.name: PACT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Operator key (0x-hex). When set, writes are signed and sent; otherwise they return unsigned transactions
